description:
Software Engineer 

 Location: Saint Inigoes, MD 

 Clearance Level : Active Top Secret 

  

 Why Rackner 

 Rackner is a software consultancy that builds cloud-native solutions for startups, enterprises, and the public sector. We are an energetic, growing consultancy focused on solving complex problems through distributed systems, DevSecOps, AI/ML, and modern systems architecture. We enable digital transformation by applying cloud-first, cost-effective innovation across mission-critical environments. Our customers span a diverse and growing set of industries, and our teams are driven by a shared focus on end-to-end system delivery and real-world impact. 

  

 What We Are Looking For 

 Rackner is supporting a critical initiative for the Navy to accelerate the delivery of agile, mission focused solutions. We are seeking a Software Engineer to develop and enhance software applications and systems to meet evolving technical and operational requirements. In this role, you will develop, maintain, and enhance software applications to improve functionality, performance, and reliability. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will help integrate systems, develop databases, and improve software to create reliable solutions that support changing business and technical needs.

  

  

  

 How You Will Contribute 

 
 Design, develop and maintain software applications, network systems, and specialized programs to meet technical and operational requirements 

 Analyze user needs and translate technical requirements into innovative and efficient software solutions 

 Modernize existing software applications to boost performance and enhance functionality to ensure system reliability 

 Collaborate with engineering teams on hardware and software integration while supporting system requirements and database development  

 
 



 What makes You a Great Fit 

 
 3+ years of software development experience, including at least 2 years supporting DoD systems 

 Experience with programming languages such as C++, C#, Java, or Python. 

 Familiarity with SQL databases, Git, and software development environments 

 Experience with software testing, troubleshooting, and integrating software with existing systems 

 
 



 Benefits & Professional Growth 

 
 Competitive compensation 

 Company-supported certifications aligned with current and future program work 

 401(k) with 100% company match up to 6% 

 Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability coverage 

 Paid time off and company holidays 

 Fitness and wellness reimbursement 

 Weekly pay schedule 

 Professional development and future growth opportunities 

 
  

 Rackner is an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
